label: Day 5 — What using it actually feels like
tweets: Enough theory. What does verifying AI code look like at 5pm on a Friday? Short thread. 🧵

Step 1 — install (one line, no daemon, no SaaS):

npm i progmune-runtime

Runs locally. Your code never leaves your machine. Static analysis: it reads files, doesn't execute them.

Step 2 — verify:

progmune src/server.ts

Verdict, not a score salad:
✅ APPROVED — clean, evidence shown
🟡 NEEDS_REVIEW — sequence + why + fix path
🔴 BLOCKED — critical lifecycle violation

Every verdict ships evidence: which sequence, which state, where to fix.

Step 3 — wire it where AI code lands:

• CI gate before merge
• Agent loop: Claude Code self-checks via MCP
• Repo governance dashboard

"Can I deploy this change?" → yes/no + proof.

Try: https://progmune.top · npm i progmune-runtime
